nav.saveFailed: Could not save. Check the connection and try again.

common.loadFailedHint: Make sure the installer is running on the server, then try again.
common.probeFailed: The check did not complete. Try again in a moment.
common.notSupportedBody: This version of the installer cannot restore from a backup yet. Go back and choose a new install.

dns.matchBody: The address points to {m}{ip}{/m}, which is this server's public address.
dns.matchIp: The address is this server's public address {m}{ip}{/m}.
dns.checkingBody: Looking up where the address points.
dns.mismatchBody: The address points to {m}{found}{/m}. This server's public address is {m}{ip}{/m}.
dns.mismatchNoRecord: The address has no record yet. This server's public address is {m}{ip}{/m}.
dns.unknownBody: The address could not be found. A record you just added can take a while to spread.
dns.unknownNoPublicIp: This server's public address could not be detected, so there is nothing to compare with.
dns.idle: Enter the address and we check whether it points to this server.
dns.invalid: That is not a valid address. Enter something like workspace.example.com.

check.title: Server check
check.lead: We check whether this server can run the install. Nothing may be failing before you continue.
check.reasonRunning: You can continue once the checks finish.
check.reasonFailed: Fix the failed items and check again to continue.
check.reasonWarn: You can continue with warnings left as they are.
check.reasonError: The checks could not run. Press Check again.

values.used_not_needed: In use · not needed by this install

ok.docker_engine: This version works with the install.
ok.docker_compose: This version works with the install.
ok.port_80: No other program uses this port.
ok.port_443: No other program uses this port.
ok.port_25: No other program uses this port.
ok.subnet: Does not overlap any other network on the server.

fix.unknown: This item could not be checked. You can still continue.
fix.docker_unreachable: Could not connect to Docker. Make sure Docker is running, then check again.
fix.docker_too_old: Docker Engine {min} or newer is required. Upgrade Docker, then check again.
fix.compose_missing: Docker Compose was not found. Install the Compose plugin, then check again.
fix.compose_too_old: Docker Compose {min} or newer is required. Upgrade the Compose plugin, then check again.
fix.cpu_too_few: At least {min} processor cores are required.
fix.cpu_below_recording: Meeting recording works best with {recommend} or more cores. On this server ({cpus}), recordings may be slow or refused. You can continue.
fix.memory_below_minimum: Even the core zone alone needs {gb} GB of memory. Add memory to the server, then check again.
fix.memory_insufficient: The zones you picked recommend {gb} GB of memory. Pick fewer zones or add memory.
fix.arch_unsupported: This processor type is not supported. Install on a {supported} server.
fix.disk_too_small: There is less free space than the install needs. Remove unused Docker images and files, then check again.
fix.disk_low: Less than {recommend_gb} GB is free. You can continue, but the disk may fill up soon.
fix.time_not_synchronized: The server clock is not synchronized. A wrong clock can break certificate issuance and sign-in, so turn time sync on.
fix.port_in_use: Another program is using port {port}. Stop it, then check again.
fix.port_25_in_use: To use the built-in mail server, stop this program first. If you will not use mail, you can continue as is.
fix.subnet_conflict: This overlaps a network the server already uses. Change the range under Advanced settings on the summary screen.
fix.internet_unreachable: The internet is unreachable. You can continue if the images are already on this server.
fix.registry_unreachable: The image registry {host} is unreachable. You can continue if the images are already on this server.

start.title: How do you want to start?
start.lead: Your choice decides which screens follow. The step list updates right away.
start.newDesc: Set the address, zones and mail one at a time.
start.quickDesc: Asks only for the address, mail and admin account. Zones are set to the collaboration bundle and can be turned on or off after the install.
start.restoreDesc: Move over from another server using its backup file.
start.answersDesc: Answer the same questions in one file and install without these screens
start.answersHow: Run {m}{command}{/m} in the server terminal. You can also download an answers file with your current choices from the summary screen.
start.answersHowNoCommand: You can download an answers file with your current choices from the summary screen.

domain.title: Address and connection
domain.lead: Set the address people will use and how this server is connected to the internet.
domain.directDesc: The server has its own public address, or a public address is mapped 1:1 to it, like a cloud server.
domain.routerDesc: A router or NAT device forwards ports to this server. After you pick zones, we list the ports to forward. Adds one step.
domain.cloudNote: Detected a cloud server. It uses a private address, but a public address is mapped 1:1 to it, so this counts as 'Directly on a public address'. Open the ports in the cloud firewall (security group).
domain.proxyDesc: A reverse proxy you already run sits in front. The next screen asks for its address. Adds one step.
domain.certUploadDesc: The next screen asks for two files
domain.certTemp: Install with a temporary certificate and issue later
domain.certTempDesc: Finishes the install with a self-signed certificate
domain.certBlocked: Automatic issuance needs the address to be confirmed as pointing to this server, because the certificate authority connects to that address to verify it. With a temporary certificate browsers show a warning; once the address is right, issue one from the admin screen.
domain.certNeedsDomain: Automatic issuance needs a domain name. Certificate authorities do not issue for a numeric address.
domain.certProxyDesc: The certificate stays on the proxy in front; this server does not issue one
domain.reasonChecking: You can continue once the address check finishes.
domain.quickLead: Set just the address people will use. Everything else uses detected values and defaults.
domain.quickLowTitle: This server's memory, {m}{have} GB{/m}, is below the {m}{need} GB{/m} recommended for the collaboration bundle.
domain.quickLowBody: The minimal bundle (core zone only, {m}{min} GB{/m}) will be installed and the mail screen is skipped. After adding memory you can turn zones on from the admin screen.
domain.quickStuckTitle: A certificate cannot be issued automatically for this address.
domain.quickStuckBody: Point the address at this server and check again, or finish the install with a temporary certificate.
domain.quickTempDesc: It is self-signed, so browsers show a warning. Once the address is right, issue one from the admin screen
domain.quickReasonStuck: Fix the address or choose the temporary certificate to continue.

proxy.title: Proxy address
proxy.lead: Tell us the address of the reverse proxy in front, and visitor addresses passed on by it will be trusted and logged.
proxy.label: Proxy address or range
proxy.hint: Only connections from this address count as coming through the proxy. Separate several with commas.
proxy.errorFormat: That is not a valid address. Enter a single address or a range.
proxy.infoTitle: Only web traffic ({m}80{/m}) goes through the proxy. The proxy handles the certificate.
proxy.infoBody: Mail ports, meeting ports (including lossless audio), code hosting and SSO/LDAP ports must reach this server directly, not through the proxy. Those ports are opened separately when you pick the zone.
proxy.reasonEmpty: Enter the proxy address to continue.
proxy.reasonFormat: Fix the proxy address to continue.

cert.title: Upload certificate
cert.lead: You need two files: the certificate and its private key. They are checked against the address as soon as you upload them.
cert.certEmpty: One file including the intermediate certificates
cert.keyEmpty: A key file without a passphrase
cert.caEmpty: Only for a certificate issued by a private CA
cert.caNote: Leave this empty for a certificate from a public certificate authority. If a private CA (such as a company CA) issued it, upload that CA certificate so the code repository sign-in integration can work. You can also leave it empty if the CA certificate is already appended to the certificate file.
cert.caBad: Not the CA that issued this certificate
cert.reasonChecking: You can continue once the check finishes.
cert.footnote: The private key is stored only on this server and never goes into the answers file.

cert_domain_missing.title: This certificate does not include the address.
cert_domain_missing.body: Upload a certificate that includes {domain}, or change the address on the previous screen.

key_mismatch.title: The private key does not match this certificate.
key_mismatch.body: Upload the key file that was created together with the certificate.

cert_expired.title: This certificate has expired.
cert_expired.body: Upload a newly issued certificate. If the address points to this server you can also choose automatic issuance on the previous screen.

cert_mail_host_missing.title: The certificate has no mail host name.
cert_mail_host_missing.body: Web access is fine, but mail apps connecting to {host} will show a certificate warning. If you will not use the mail zone, you can continue as is.

cert_not_pem.title: The certificate file cannot be read.
cert_not_pem.body: Check that it is a PEM certificate file and upload it again.

key_not_pem.title: The private key file cannot be read.
key_not_pem.body: Check that it is a PEM key file and upload it again.

key_encrypted.title: The private key is protected by a passphrase.
key_encrypted.body: Upload a key file with the passphrase removed.

cert_not_yet_valid.title: This certificate is not valid yet.
cert_not_yet_valid.body: Check that the server clock is right, or upload a certificate that is valid now.

cert_expires_soon.title: The certificate expires in {days} days.
cert_expires_soon.body: You can continue. Replace it from the admin screen before it expires.

cert_self_signed.title: This is a self-signed certificate.
cert_self_signed.body: You can continue, but browsers will show a warning.

cert_chain_missing.title: The certificate file does not include its issuing CA.
cert_chain_missing.body: You can continue. For a certificate from a public certificate authority, it is better to upload a file with the intermediate certificates appended. If a private CA issued it, upload that CA certificate in the CA certificate slot above — otherwise the code repository sign-in integration stays pending (you can upload just the CA certificate later from the admin screen).

ca_not_pem.title: The CA certificate file cannot be read.
ca_not_pem.body: Check that it is a PEM certificate file and upload it again.

ca_is_private_key.title: The CA certificate slot contains a private key.
ca_is_private_key.body: Upload only the CA's certificate (public information) here. Never upload the CA's private key.

ca_not_a_ca.title: The file in the CA certificate slot is not a CA certificate.
ca_not_a_ca.body: Upload the certificate of the CA that issued your certificate, not the server certificate.

ca_not_issuer.title: This CA did not issue the uploaded certificate.
ca_not_issuer.body: Upload the certificate of the CA named as the issuer. If an intermediate CA issued it, include the intermediate CA certificate as well.

other.title: These files cannot be used.
other.body: Check that the certificate and private key are the right files and upload again. ({code})

reason.cert_domain_missing: Upload a certificate that includes the address to continue.
reason.key_mismatch: Upload the matching private key to continue.
reason.cert_expired: Upload a certificate that has not expired to continue.
reason.other: Upload a usable certificate to continue.

storage.title: Where should files be stored?
storage.lead: Documents in the Files tab, chat attachments and archived mail attachments are stored here. Moving later means copying everything, so decide now.
storage.nfsDesc: Store on a shared folder of a NAS or file server
storage.dirHint: The folder must already exist on this server. Leave empty to use the default folder.
storage.dirOkFree: This folder can be used · {gb} GB free
storage.dirNotFound: There is no such folder on this server. Create it first, then check again.
storage.dirNotWritable: This folder is not writable. Fix its permissions, then check again.
storage.dirError: The folder could not be checked. Check the path again.
storage.dirFormat: Enter a full path starting with /.
storage.checkHint: Five checks run in order. Checks 1 to 4 must pass to continue.

stepNotes.lock: Needed for co-editing and resumable uploads

cause.unreachable: The server is unreachable. Check the server address and that the firewall between the NAS and this server allows the NFS port.
cause.permission_denied: The NAS refused the connection. In the NAS share settings, check that this server's address has write access and that account mapping is right.
cause.read_only: The share is read-only. Change it to read/write in the NAS share settings.
cause.no_locking: File locking does not work. Without locking, co-editing and resumable uploads break, so this storage cannot be used. Turn on NFS locking on the NAS.
cause.export_not_found: The server is reachable, but this share path cannot be mounted. Check the path and that the NAS share settings export it to this server's address.
cause.marker_missing: This share has no marker left by the original server. It is a different share, or it is empty. Enter the server address and share path the original server used.
cause.other_install: This share is used by a different installation. Enter the server address and share path the original server used.
cause.other: This check stopped. Review the NAS settings, then check again. ({cause})

storage.spaceLow: Less than 10 GB is free. You can continue, but it may fill up soon.
storage.spaceUnknown: Free space could not be read. You can continue.
storage.fixedNote: The database and mailboxes always stay on this server's disk, whatever the storage type.
storage.reasonInput: Enter the server address and share path, then press Test connection to continue.
storage.reasonChecking: You can continue once the check finishes.
storage.reasonFailed: Checks 1 to 4 must all pass to continue.
storage.reasonDir: Check the storage folder to continue.
storage.reasonDirBad: Enter a usable storage folder to continue.

zones.title: Pick the zones to use
zones.lead: Only the zones you pick are installed. You can turn them on or off later from the admin screen.
zones.memUnknown: Server memory is unknown, so this was not compared
zones.overAlert: The zones you picked recommend {m}{n} GB{/m} more memory than this server has. Pick fewer zones to continue.
zones.reasonOver: Recommended memory is more than the server has.
zones.reasonRequires: A zone that must be picked together is missing.
zones.voiceNeedsMeetings: Voice channels need the Meetings zone to be picked as well
zones.thirdParty: Components made elsewhere, such as the document editor, the meeting server and code hosting, are downloaded from their original publisher when you turn the zone on.
zones.loadFailed: The zone list could not be loaded.

ports.title: Ports to open on the router
ports.lead: These are the ports the zones you picked need. In the router settings, forward them to this server's internal address {m}{ip}{/m}.
ports.leadNoIp: These are the ports the zones you picked need. In the router settings, forward them to this server's internal address.
ports.howBody: After the install, open the address from an outside network such as mobile data. If it does not open, check the router's port forwarding and whether your provider blocks the port. The installer does not test whether ports are open.

use.7881/tcp: Video and audio (when UDP is blocked)

mail.title: How should mail be sent?
mail.lead: With the built-in server you register five records on the mail domain. The install continues even if they are not all done yet.
mail.builtinDesc: This server sends and receives directly
mail.externalDesc: Send through an SMTP server you already use
mail.domainError: That is not a valid domain. Enter something like example.com.
mail.recordsTitle: Records to register on the mail domain
mail.recordsIdle: Enter the mail domain to see the records to register.
mail.recordsWarnTitle: {m}{n}{/m} records do not match. If you install like this, mail you send may be marked as spam.
mail.recordsWarnBody: You can check again from the admin screen after the install. If your provider blocks port {m}25{/m}, the built-in server cannot send, so choose an external relay.

smtp.unreachable: The relay is unreachable. Check the server address and port.
smtp.tls_failed: An encrypted connection could not be made. Check the port and encryption method.

mail.reasonDomain: Enter the mail domain to continue.
mail.reasonSmtp: The relay connection must be confirmed to continue.

meet.title: Meeting connectivity
meet.lead: In video meetings, media travels directly between participants and the server, so the server needs its own way in from outside.
meet.addressBadBody: This server's public address could not be detected. Enter it below.
meet.addressError: That is not a valid address. Enter something like 203.0.113.24.
meet.relayOnDesc: Participants who cannot connect directly can still join
meet.relayOffDesc: Only participants who can connect directly can join
meet.relayNeedsDomain: The built-in relay needs the address to be a domain name.
meet.losslessDesc: For meetings where sound quality matters, such as music lessons or ensembles. Opens one more port, UDP 4433
meet.losslessNeedsChat: Lossless audio needs the Chat zone to be picked as well.
meet.how: How to check yourself: after the install, start a meeting from an outside network and see whether video flows. The installer does not test whether ports are open.
meet.reasonAddress: Enter the public address to continue.

ai.title: Connect the AI assistant
ai.lead: This needs a key from an external AI provider. If you do not have one now, connect later from the admin screen.
ai.nowDesc: Enter a key and test it
ai.laterDesc: The AI assistant stays off until connected
ai.baseUrlHint: The address of the server you run yourself.
ai.keyPlaceholder: The key copied from the provider
ai.keyHint: The key is stored only on this server and never goes into the answers file.
ai.keyOptional: Leave empty if your server needs no key.
ai.okBody: The provider answered with this key.
ai.keyError: This key does not connect. Check that the provider and key are right.
ai.unreachable: The provider is unreachable. Check the server's internet access and the server address.
ai.error: The provider returned an error. Try again in a moment.
ai.reason: The key must be confirmed to continue.

git.title: Code hosting version
git.lead: Downloading, configuring and connecting to the workspace are done automatically. Here you only choose the version to download.
git.verifiedDesc: Tested to work with this workspace version
git.verifiedDescVersion: Tested to work with this workspace version · {version}
git.latestDesc: Downloads the newest version from the original publisher
git.versionError: That is not a valid version. Use digits, dots, hyphens and letters only.
git.untestedBody: Sign-in integration or the repository list may not work correctly. If there is a problem you can switch to the verified version from the admin screen.
git.orderNote: The install screen shows the progress of these three steps separately. Port {m}{ports}{/m} is opened for repository access (SSH).
git.orderNoteNoPort: The install screen shows the progress of these three steps separately.
git.reasonVersion: Type the version to download to continue.

advanced.title: Advanced settings
advanced.lead: Most installs need no changes here. Anything left alone uses its default. File storage is set in its own step earlier.
advanced.subnetClash: {subnet} · overlaps another network on the server
advanced.subnetHint: Used only for zones to talk to each other. It just must not overlap another network on the server.
advanced.subnetErrorClash: This overlaps a network the server already uses. Enter a different range.
advanced.reason: Fix the internal range to go back.

admin.title: Admin account
admin.lead: This is the first account of the workspace. Invite other people after the install.
admin.name: Name
admin.usernameError: This contains characters that cannot be used. Start with a lowercase letter or digit and use 3 to 32 lowercase letters, digits, dots, underscores or hyphens.
admin.usernameErrorRule: This contains characters that cannot be used. {rule}
admin.passwordShort: At least {min} characters are required. This has {n}.
admin.passwordKept: The password you entered earlier is saved on the server. Type a new one to change it.
admin.reasonPasswordShort: The password must be at least {min} characters to continue.
admin.reasonPasswordMismatch: Both passwords must be the same to continue.
admin.resetNote: If you forget the password, set a new one by running {m}{command}{/m} in the server terminal.

summary.title: Ready to install
summary.lead: Nothing has changed on the server yet. Pressing Install applies everything at once.
summary.leadRetry: Settings and containers from the earlier install attempt are still on the server. Pressing Install applies your current choices again and cleans up the containers of zones you removed.
summary.zonesQuickNote: turn on other zones from the admin screen after the install

caution.port_25_in_use: Another program is using mail port {m}25{/m}. The built-in mail server may fail to start.
caution.mail_records_pending: {m}{n}{/m} mail records do not match. Mail you send may be marked as spam.
caution.mail_records_both: {m}{missing}{/m} mail records are missing and {m}{different}{/m} have a different value. Mail you send may be marked as spam.
caution.cert_temporary: The install uses a temporary certificate. Browsers show a warning until you issue one from the admin screen.
caution.docs_temporary_cert: With a temporary certificate, the document editor may not open because of the certificate warning. Switching to a trusted certificate fixes this.
caution.meetings_recording_low_cpu: Meeting recording works best with {m}{recommend}{/m} or more cores. On this server ({m}{cpus}{/m}), recordings may be slow or refused.
caution.quick_downgraded: Server memory is below what the collaboration bundle recommends, so the minimal bundle is installed.
caution.disk_low: Free disk space is low. It may fill up soon.
caution.time_not_synchronized: The server clock is not synchronized. Certificate issuance and sign-in may fail.
caution.internet_unreachable: The internet is unreachable. Images may fail to download.
caution.registry_unreachable: The image registry is unreachable. Images may fail to download.
caution.nfs_space_low: The network storage is low on free space.
caution.hairpin_not_configured: The proxy address is not a single address, so the path back to the address from inside the server could not be set up. Document editing and code hosting integration may not work.
caution.git_sso_needs_trusted_cert: Sign-in integration for code hosting does not work with a temporary certificate. It works once a certificate is issued.
caution.proxy_side_certs_self_signed: Names that do not go through the proxy ({m}{names}{/m}) use a self-signed certificate. Mail apps may show a certificate warning.
caution.turn_tls_alternate_port: The encrypted meeting relay uses port {m}{port}{/m}.
caution.no_system_mail: The mail zone is not selected, so invitations and password reset mail cannot be sent.
caution.meetings_public_ip_unknown: The public address for meetings is unknown. People outside may not be able to join meetings.
caution.rbi_needs_dns: The isolated browser also needs {m}{name}{/m} to point to this server.
caution.dns_mismatch_cert_will_fail: The address does not point to this server, so automatic certificate issuance will fail.
caution.router_port_forward: Forward these ports on your router or NAT device to this server so it can be reached from outside: {m}{ports}{/m}
caution.lossless_needs_udp_4433: Lossless audio needs UDP port {m}4433{/m} reachable from outside. Otherwise calls fall back to standard quality.
caution.mail_needs_dns_and_port25: The built-in mail server needs the mail records of {m}{mail_domain}{/m} and inbound port {m}25{/m} to receive mail.
caution.account_domain_is_mail_domain: Account mail addresses will look like {m}name@{mail_domain}{/m}.
caution.side_certs_self_signed: Names that bypass the proxy ({m}{names}{/m}) got a self-signed certificate.
caution.cert_renewal_not_started: The automatic certificate renewal container could not be started. The installer keeps retrying. After installation, check the renewal status under Security in the admin screen.

summary.errorsTitle: This cannot be installed as it is

error.memory_insufficient: The zones you picked recommend more memory than the server has.
error.memory_below_minimum: The server has less memory than the minimum the install needs.
error.cert_upload_missing: There is no uploaded certificate. Upload it again on the certificate screen.
error.cert_temporary_needs_dns_check: The address needs to be checked again.
error.subnet_conflict: The internal range overlaps another network on the server.
error.restore_not_supported: Restoring from a backup is not supported yet. Choose another way to start.
error.zone_requires: A zone that must be picked together is missing.
error.turn_needs_domain: The built-in relay needs the address to be a domain name.
error.lossless_needs_chat: Lossless audio needs the Chat zone as well.
error.cert_auto_needs_domain: Automatic certificate issuance needs a domain name.
error.cert_temporary_not_allowed: A temporary certificate can only be chosen when the address does not point to this server.

summary.downloadNote: Reuse the same settings on another server. Passwords and keys are not included in the file.
summary.reasonErrors: Fix the items above to install.
summary.reasonLoadFailed: Could not check what will be installed.
summary.startFailed: The install could not start. Press again.
summary.reasonPreflight: The server check must pass before installing.

apply.leadRunning: The install continues even if you close this window. Open the same address again to pick up where it is.
apply.leadFailed: It stopped at one step. Steps that already finished stay as they are.
apply.configImageNote: Downloading the backend image first; it is used to generate the secret keys. The other images are downloaded in the "Download images" step.

steps.config: Create configuration files and secret keys

restoreSteps.unpack: Unpack the backup and create configuration files
restoreSteps.zones: Start zones and lock the installer

apply.logFailed: The log could not be loaded.
apply.retryFailed: Could not restart. Press again in a moment.

cert_issue_failed.title: Could not get a certificate for {m}{domain}{/m}.
cert_issue_failed.body: Check the certificate authority's response in the log, then try again. If you cannot fix it now, finish the install with a temporary (self-signed) certificate and issue one later from the admin screen.

cert_service_start_failed.title: Could not start the certificate container.
cert_service_start_failed.body: It stopped inside the server before any request reached the certificate authority. Check the log, then try again.

cert_acme_challenge_failed.title: The certificate authority could not fetch the check file from port {m}80{/m} of {m}{domain}{/m}.
cert_acme_challenge_failed.body: Check that port {m}80{/m} is open to this server on the firewall or port forwarding, then try again. If you cannot open it now, finish the install with a temporary (self-signed) certificate and issue one later from the admin screen.

cert_rate_limited.title: The certificate authority's issuance limit was exceeded.
cert_rate_limited.body: Wait a while and try again, or finish the install with a temporary (self-signed) certificate and issue one later from the admin screen.

cert_dns_mismatch.title: {m}{domain}{/m} has no DNS record or does not point to this server.
cert_dns_mismatch.body: Point every name in the certificate ({m}{names}{/m}) to this server's public address, then try again. If you cannot do that now, finish the install with a temporary (self-signed) certificate and issue one later from the admin screen.

database_migrate_failed.title: Could not bring the database up to this version.
database_migrate_failed.body: Check the log, then try again. Steps that already finished are not repeated.

storage.title: The network storage {m}{target}{/m} could not be mounted.
storage.body: Settings on the NAS or the network may have changed since the check on the file storage screen. Make sure the NAS is on and try again, or edit the file storage.

storage_local.title: The storage folder cannot be used.
storage_local.body: Check that the folder still exists and is writable and try again, or edit the file storage.

image_pull_failed.title: The image {m}{image}{/m} could not be downloaded.
image_pull_failed.body: Check the server's internet access, then try again. Images already downloaded are not downloaded again.

database_not_ready.title: The database did not start.
database_not_ready.body: Check the log, then try again.

service_not_ready.title: The component {m}{container}{/m} did not start.
service_not_ready.body: Check the log, then try again.

zone.title: The install stopped while setting up the {zone} zone.
zone.body: Check the log, then try again. If it keeps stopping, go back to the summary, leave this zone out, and turn it on later from the admin screen.

answers_invalid.title: Some of the values you entered cannot be used.
answers_invalid.body: Go back to the summary, fix the marked items, and install again.

preflight_failed.title: An item in the server check started failing.
preflight_failed.body: Fix it on the server check screen, then try again.

admin_username_taken.title: The admin username {m}{username}{/m} is already in use.
admin_username_taken.body: Go back to the summary, change the username, and try again.

cert_invalid.title: The uploaded certificate cannot be used.
cert_invalid.body: Go back to the summary, upload the certificate again, and try again.

restore_database_failed.title: Restoring data from the backup stopped.
restore_database_failed.body: Steps that already finished stay as they are. If it stops at the same place again, download the log and look into it, then create a fresh backup on the original server and upload it.

restore_backup_missing.title: The uploaded backup file could not be found.
restore_backup_missing.body: Go back to the review, upload the backup file again, then restore.

restore_config_failed.title: Configuration files could not be created from the backup's settings.
restore_config_failed.body: Check the log, then try again. If it keeps stopping at the same place, create a fresh backup on the original server and upload it.

restore_files_failed.title: Restoring files from the backup stopped.
restore_files_failed.body: Check that the file location has free space and is writable, then try again. Steps that already finished stay as they are.

storage_marker_missing.title: This share has no marker left by the original server.
storage_marker_missing.body: It is a different share, or it is empty. Go back to the review and enter the share the original server used.

storage_other_install.title: This share is used by a different installation.
storage_other_install.body: Go back to the review and enter the share the original server used.

restore_version_newer.title: This backup was created by a newer version than the one being installed.
restore_version_newer.body: Download the latest install script and start over.

restore_storage.title: The file location could not be prepared.
restore_storage.body: For network storage, check that the NAS is on and try again, or go back to the review and change where files are kept.

other.title: It stopped at this step.
other.body: Check the log, then try again. Steps that already finished are not repeated.

apply.doneNote: The installer is now locked. You will be taken to the completion screen in a moment.
apply.footnote: When it finishes, the installer locks and moves on to the completion screen. After that, change settings from the admin screen.
apply.streamLost: Progress cannot be read right now. The install continues on the server.

done.title: The install is complete
done.lead: The installer is locked. From now on, use the address below.
done.certDesc: A temporary certificate is in use, so browsers show a warning. Issue one once the address points to this server
done.inviteDesc: Invite by mail address or create an invite link
done.recordsDesc: {n} records do not match, so mail you send may be marked as spam

locked.title: The install is already complete
locked.lead: The installer at this address is locked. Change settings from the admin screen after signing in.
locked.reinstall: To reinstall the server from scratch, run {m}{command}{/m} in the server terminal. All current data will be erased.

token.title: Enter the setup token
token.leadNone: If you open the address printed in the terminal, you skip this screen. If you typed the address yourself, enter the token here.
token.leadOther: Only the person who started the install on this server can continue.
token.label: Setup token
token.errorWrong: The token is not right. Check the value shown in the terminal again.
token.errorLocked: Too many wrong tries. Enter it again in {sec} seconds.
token.errorLockedNoTime: Too many wrong tries. Enter it again in a moment.
token.errorNetwork: Could not verify. Check the connection and press again.
token.help: Enter the value on the last line of the terminal where you ran the install command. It is {m}12{/m} uppercase letters and digits.
token.expiredTitle: A token stops working {m}24{/m} hours after it is created.
token.expiredBody: Run {m}{command}{/m} in the server terminal to get an address with a new token. Open that address and the install continues with what you already entered.
token.expiredBodyNoCommand: Issue a new token in the server terminal to get an address with it. Open that address and the install continues with what you already entered.

resume.leadTyping: What you entered before closing the window is still on this server.
resume.leadApplying: The install kept going while the window was closed.
resume.leadFailed: A step failed while the window was closed and the install stopped.
resume.secretsNote: Passwords and keys are not saved, so you will need to enter them again on their screens.
resume.failedBody: Steps that already finished stay as they are. On the install screen you can see the cause and retry from that step.

restore.fileLead: You need one backup file created from the admin screen of the other server.
restore.wayLabel: How to provide the backup file
restore.wayPath: Path to a file on the server
restore.pathLabel: Path to the backup file on the server
restore.pathHint: For a large backup it is faster to copy it to the server first and give its path.
restore.pathError: There is no file at this path, or it cannot be read. Check the path and the file permissions.
restore.goodBody: The file is intact and this version can restore it.
restore.badBody: It is not a Just Workspace backup file, or it was damaged in transit. Download the backup again from the original server.
restore.uploadFailed: The file could not be uploaded. Check the connection and upload again.
restore.reasonEmpty: Upload a backup file to continue.
restore.reasonUploading: The file is checked once the upload finishes.
restore.reasonBad: Upload a backup file that can be restored to continue.
restore.reasonPathEmpty: Enter a path and press Check file to continue.
restore.reasonPathChecking: You can continue once the check finishes.
restore.reasonPathBad: Enter the path of a readable backup file to continue.
restore.verifying: Checking · verifying that the file is intact. A large backup takes a few minutes.
restore.checkingBody: The uploaded backup file is being checked. A large backup takes a few minutes.

bad.not_a_backup: It is not a Just Workspace backup file. Upload a backup file created from the admin screen of the original server.
bad.format_unsupported: This installer does not know this backup format. Download the latest install script and start over.
bad.no_config: This backup contains no settings, so it cannot be moved to a new server. Create a full backup on the original server.
bad.path_invalid: This path cannot be used. Enter the full path of a backup file or backup folder on the server.
bad.corrupt: It was damaged in transit. Download the backup again from the original server and upload it.
bad.not_found: The file could not be found. Upload it again.

uploadError.no_space: The server does not have enough free space. {need} is needed but only {free} is left. Free up space, then upload again.
uploadError.apply_running: A restore is already running, so the backup cannot be replaced.
uploadError.upload_invalid: The upload could not be read. Choose the file and upload it again.

restore.passwordTitle: This backup is protected by a password.
restore.passwordBody: Enter the password set when the backup was created on the original server to read its settings.
restore.passwordWrong: The password is wrong. Enter it again.
restore.reasonChecking: You can continue once the file check finishes.
restore.reasonPassword: Enter the backup password and check it to continue.
restore.reviewLead: Nothing has changed on the server yet. Pressing Restore moves over the settings and data in the backup as they are.
restore.versionNewer: {version} · newer than the version being installed
restore.filesNfs: None · files on network storage are not put in backups
restore.filesNone: None · not included when the backup was made
restore.targetTitle: Where to keep files on this server
restore.nfsDescReconnect: Reconnect the share the original server used
restore.nfsDescMove: Move the files in the backup onto this share
restore.localOff: This backup contains no files. Reconnect the share the original server used to see the files.
restore.noFilesBody: Files were not included when the backup was made. After the restore, the Files tab and chat and mail attachments will be empty. To move files too, create the backup again on the original server with files included.
restore.nfsIdle: Runs the same five checks as the file storage screen.
restore.nfsChecking: Checking · running the five checks in order.
restore.nfsPermissionExtra: The new server has a different address, so access must be granted again.
restore.addressHint: Filled in with the same address as the backup. If you change it, mail records must be registered again too.
restore.dnsWarnTitle: The address does not point to this server yet. You can still restore.
restore.dnsWarnBody: A temporary certificate is installed. When you are ready to move, point the address's record at this server and issue a certificate from the admin screen. Until then people keep using the original server.
restore.verBadTitle: This backup was made on a newer version than the one being installed.
restore.verBadBody: Download the latest install script and start over. Backup {m}{backup}{/m} · installing {m}{installer}{/m}
restore.reasonVersion: A backup of this version cannot be restored.
restore.reasonNfsFailed: Checks 1 to 4 must all pass to restore.
restore.reasonNfs: The network storage connection must be confirmed to restore.
restore.reasonDnsChecking: You can restore once the address check finishes.
restore.reviewFailed: The backup contents could not be read.
restore.startFailed: The restore could not start. Press again.
restore.blockedTitle: This backup cannot be restored on this server.

blocker.memory_insufficient: The zones in the backup need {need} GB of recommended memory, but this server has {have} GB. Add memory to the server, then start again.
blocker.memory_below_minimum: This server's {have} GB of memory is below the {need} GB minimum needed to install. Add memory to the server, then start again.

restore.reasonBlocked: Resolve the reasons above to restore.
restore.nfsMarkerTitle: This share cannot be used to restore.
restore.reasonNfsMarker: Connect the share the original server used to restore.

networkNote.direct: The server holds a public address directly.
networkNote.router: The router must forward ports to this server before it can be reached from outside.
networkNote.proxy: The proxy in front handles the certificate; this server does not issue one.

restore.reasonProxy: Enter the proxy address to restore.
restore.reasonSubnet: Fix the internal subnet to restore.
restore.startErrorTitle: The restore cannot start like this.
restore.reasonStartErrors: Fix the items above, then press again.

startError.storage_must_be_nfs: This backup contains no files, so the network storage the original server used must be reconnected.
startError.storage_marker_missing: This share has no marker left by the original server. It is a different share, or it is empty.
startError.storage_other_install: This share is used by a different installation.
startError.version_newer: This backup was created by a newer version than the one being installed.
startError.memory_insufficient: The recommended memory of the zones in the backup exceeds the server memory.
startError.memory_below_minimum: The server memory is below the minimum needed to install.
startError.other: The server did not accept the values. ({code})

restore.applyLeadRunning: The restore continues even if you close this window. Open the same address again to pick up where it is.
restore.applyFootnote: When it finishes, the installer locks and moves on to the completion screen. Accounts and passwords stay as they were on the original server.
restore.doneLead: Accounts, passwords and data are as they were on the original server. The installer is locked.

doneFiles.restored: The files in the backup were restored too.
doneFiles.not_included: Restored without files — the Files tab and chat and mail attachments are empty.
doneFiles.nfs: The network storage was reconnected — the files are still on that storage.

restore.moveDesc: Point the address's record at this server and people will connect here
restore.recordsDesc: The server address changed, so check the mail records again
restore.backupDesc: The original server's backup schedule was carried over. Check that the destination is right
restore.oldDesc: Turn it off after confirming the move. Using both servers at once splits the data
